title: Part One: Alex Karp: How Palantir's CEO Went From Marxist To Anti-Woke Crusader
description:
Robert begins his exploration of the early life of Alex Karp, current CEO of Palantir and best friend to Peter Thiel. He traces Alex's journey from left-wing academic to overlord of an "Anti-Woke" defense contractor.
